title: The Lantern at the Edge of the Woods
description: A young unicorn follows an unlit lantern into the dusk and discovers why some paths only brighten when they are shared.
catalogueBlurb: A young unicorn follows a mysterious lantern into the dusk with a friend.
author: Quill

cover.alt: Rowan stands at the edge of the woods as a green-gold glowmoth appears beside the old unlit lantern.
